- b) Reference: the almonds (2.3 cm) run about 40 px in the photo, and the plate spans about 480 px. That gives 480 / 40 x 2.3 ≈ 27 cm.
- Final width: 26 cm. Area = 0.785 x 26² ≈ 531 cm².

STEP 4 - Hidden food: no base layer is visible. The only hidden items are the almonds counted above.
